Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: Spotify API sync

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

env:
  SPEC_URL: https://developer.spotify.com/reference/web-api/open-api-schema.yaml
  SNAPSHOT: tool/spotify-openapi.yaml
  OASDIFF_VERSION: 1.33.0

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Fetch current spec
        run: curl -fsSL "$SPEC_URL" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/spec-new.yaml"

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check
        run: |
          if cmp -s "$SNAPSHOT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/spec-new.yaml"; then
            echo "Spec unchanged."
            echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Install oasdiff
        if: steps.check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          curl -fsSL "https://github.com/oasdiff/oasdiff/releases/download/v${OASDIFF_VERSION}/oasdiff_${OASDIFF_VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz" \
            | tar -xz -C "$RUNNER_TEMP" oasdiff

      - name: Generate changelog
        if: steps.check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          # Spotify's spec has a boolean `required` on a schema, which oasdiff can't parse.
          # Only the copies used for diffing are normalized, the snapshot stays as published.
          normalize='del(.. | select(type == "!!map" and has("required") and (.required | type) == "!!bool" and (has("in") | not)) | .required)'
          yq "$normalize" "$SNAPSHOT" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/base.yaml"
          yq "$normalize" "$RUNNER_TEMP/spec-new.yaml" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/revision.yaml"

          if ! "$RUNNER_TEMP/oasdiff" changelog "$RUNNER_TEMP/base.yaml" "$RUNNER_TEMP/revision.yaml" --format markdown > "$RUNNER_TEMP/changelog.md"; then
            echo "_oasdiff failed - check the workflow logs and diff the snapshot manually._" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/changelog.md"
          fi

          {
            echo "The [Spotify Web API spec]($SPEC_URL) changed since the last snapshot."
            echo
            if grep -q '^### ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/changelog.md"; then
              # PR bodies are limited to 65536 characters
              head -c 60000 "$RUNNER_TEMP/changelog.md"
            else
              echo "No API changes detected by oasdiff - probably only descriptions or formatting changed."
            fi
            echo
            echo "_Opened by the [Spotify API sync workflow](https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/workflows/spotify-api-sync.yml)._"
          } > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pr-body.md"

          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/spec-new.yaml" "$SNAPSHOT"

      - name: Open or update PR
        if: steps.check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v8
        with:
          branch: chore/spotify-api-sync
          commit-message: Update Spotify Web API spec snapshot
          title: Spotify Web API spec changed
          body-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/pr-body.md
          delete-branch: true

Pattern: P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW (workflow_skip)

When is skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs applicable?

Assess skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Repository policy permits a specific run to be omitted

Contraindications: Strict contract requires all triggers to execute

Method: Treat as behavior-changing rather than a safe default; Require evidence about affected checks

Reported finding: Explicit skipping has limited aggregate impact.

Reported metrics: {"comparison": "less_than", "paid_vm_time_reduction_upper_bound_percent": 0.1}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.2.4; Table 4; PDF pp. 7: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

trigger CI for each submitted revision
